name: Wasabi Hot Cloud Storage
tax_note: Tax collection doc: 'The prices listed on Wasabi's website do not include any indirect taxes. Indirect taxes, if applicable, will be added to your invoice as a separate line item.' VAT/GST is collected in the EU, UK, Canada, India and Japan; US sales tax per state.

regions.note: EU West 1 (United Kingdom; the doc gives no city). Alias s3.uk-1.wasabisys.com.
EU West 3 (United Kingdom; the doc gives no city). Alias s3.uk-2.wasabisys.com.

storage_classes.name: Wasabi Object Storage (Pay as You Go)

price.note: Pricing FAQ: '$7.99 TB/mo ($0.0078 GB/mo)', listed identically for North America, EMEA and APAC, so applied to all regions. Wasabi's own conversion uses 1 TB = 1024 GB: '($7.99) / (1024 GB per TB) = $.0078 GB/mo' (exact quotient 0.0078027). Minimum monthly charge equals 1 TB of active storage (see notes).

put_per_1000.note: Pricing FAQ table: 'API Requests = Free*' (*subject to Wasabi's free egress and API request policies); the invoice shows the request volume but does not charge it.

get_per_1000.note: Pricing FAQ table: 'API Requests = Free*' (*subject to Wasabi's free egress and API request policies); the invoice shows the request volume but does not charge it.

list_per_1000.note: Pricing FAQ table: 'API Requests = Free*' (*subject to Wasabi's free egress and API request policies); the invoice shows the request volume but does not charge it.

price_per_gb.note: No retrieval fee line in the pricing FAQ; absence of a line item, not an explicit statement.

typical_delay.note: Not stated in the sources checked.

minimum_storage_duration_days.note: Pricing FAQ: objects deleted before 90 days (Pay as You Go) incur a Timed Deleted Storage charge for the remaining days. Reserved Capacity Storage uses 30 days; the 90-to-30-day change on request is described in the minimum storage duration doc (https://docs.wasabi.com/docs/how-does-wasabis-minimum-storage-duration-policy-work).

minimum_billable_object_size_kb.note: Pricing FAQ: 'Wasabi's minimum file size from a charging perspective is 4 KB'; smaller objects are billed as 4 KB.

notes: Minimum monthly charge: Pay as You Go accounts are charged for at least 1 TB of active storage per month (pricing FAQ).
Overwriting an object counts as deleting the old version: it incurs deleted-storage charges for the rest of the minimum period (pricing FAQ).
Reserved Capacity Storage (1, 3 or 5 year terms) is not modelled.

free_allowance_gb_per_month.note: Not a metered allowance: egress is free subject to the free egress policy (monthly egress at most the active storage volume), see egress_fair_use.

egress.free_allowance_scope: Free egress policy: monthly egress up to the account's active storage volume is a good fit; exceeding it regularly may lead to limits or suspension.

price.note: Pricing FAQ table: 'Egress Data Transfer = Free*', subject to the free egress policy; no per-GB overage price is published.

egress_fair_use.value: If monthly egress is less than or equal to the active storage volume the use case fits the free egress policy; if it is greater, it does not, and Wasabi reserves the right to limit or suspend service when this happens regularly.
egress_fair_use.note: The free API request policy is similar: validated commercial applications are generally compliant; inefficient non-validated applications may be limited or suspended.

free_tier.value: No permanent free tier. Free trial: 100 GB for 30 days with a company email domain, 10 GB for 14 days with a freemail domain; no credit card required.
free_tier.note: The docs index entry 'Signing Up for Wasabi' says 'store up to 1 TB for 30 days'; the sign-up page values are used here.

object_lock.note: Object Lock with governance and compliance retention modes and legal hold; a bucket uses either Object Lock or Wasabi's Compliance feature, not both.

s3_endpoints.note: Service URL s3.wasabisys.com (alias s3.us-east-1.wasabisys.com). REST API introduction: Wasabi supports path-style and virtual-hosted requests and 'recommends using path-style requests' for flexibility in bucket names.

notes: Prices exclude indirect taxes (tax collection doc https://docs.wasabi.com/docs/how-does-wasabi-handle-tax-collection).
Wasabi lists prices in USD only on the pages checked; no EUR price list was found.
Use the service URL that matches the bucket's region; a wrong regional URL allows GET but not PUT or DELETE (S3 API reference).
Wasabi Cloud NAS ($9.99/TB/mo) and Surveillance Cloud are separate products and are not modelled.
